item.title: Curating for @WeAreRLadies on Twitter
item.description:
TL; DR

In February 2021 I tweeted to a daunting >20k followers by curating for @WeAreLadies on Twitter. This was great opportunity to share knowledge, interact with others, and learn something in return, ultimately cultivating new connections and collaborations. From preparation to fruition, I hope this post helps you confidently enroll as a curator!

item.title: The R-Ladies Mentoring Program: R-Ladies Cotonou journey
item.description:
How it all started …? 🤔

R-Ladies Cotonou is a local chapter of R-Ladies Global located in Cotonou, Benin (West Africa). To date, we have 30 members with four women in the organizing team. The idea of creating R-Ladies Cotonou was born on Twitter! Here’s the story!
